newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel steady, buoyed by good crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel steady, buoyed by good crude.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil markets were encouraged by higher crude and held steady at levels deterring European buyers, traders said.
"There is neither urgent buying nor selling," said one trader.
Offer levels were still around the $99-$100 level with sellers hoping better Brent crude will make those values stick.
But European buyers were unconvinced and unsure there was enough U.S. demand to support the market.
"For bog standard material I can't seen anyone interested at the moment and certainly no-one at higher than the mid $90's," one potential purchaser said.
Russian straight-runs were being actively marketed out of the Black Sea, with an E-4 heard traded at $94 cif Antwerp.
M-100 cargoes were discussed at around $3-$5 above two means, while M-40s were talked $2.50 over two means.
